ns2:course.label: Mathematical Economics
ns2:course.description: Introduction to game theory with applications to economics; emphasizes the analysis of static and dynamic games with or without complete information. 3 undergraduate hours. 2 or 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: One of MATH 125, MATH 225, MATH 415; one of MATH 241 (formerly MATH 243) or MATH 242, or equivalent; ECON 302.
